title: Southlands Riding Club
specs: 16 acres of equestrian facilities including indoor arena, covered arena, outdoor rings, grass field, cross-country schooling area, and half-mile track
No horses available for public riding; must bring own horse or use club-sanctioned instructors with lesson horses
Approved riding helmet and boots with a heel recommended for lessons
Clubhouse rental accommodates up to 100 people (150 including patio)

blurb: Southlands Riding Club provides 16 acres of equestrian facilities including indoor and outdoor arenas, rings for dressage and jumping, a grass field, cross-country schooling area, and a half-mile track. The club operates daily from 6:00am to 9:00pm with lighting for evening riding.
extraNote: Memberships are annual and may be pro-rated if joining part way through the year (Nov 1 to Oct 31) · GST added to dues; 3% convenience fee for credit card payments · All incidents, injuries and near misses must be reported to the General Manager
